document.title: Sell from Reel comments

source.description_exact: A reel got people talking? Slide into their DMs with something worth buying
source.preview_text_exact:
Instagram
Sell from Reel comments
Business value
Likes are cute. Sales are better. This turns your comment section into a checkout line.
How does it work?

Someone drops a comment on your Reel. Your automation jumps in with a DM and a discount, product link, or cheeky upsell. One comment = full funnel.

selection.choose_when: Use a Reel comment to deliver a coupon and an unconditional two-minute help message.
selection.avoid_when: Do not describe the follow-up as conditional on no click. Copy's 48-hour expiry is not enforced.

safety.delivery_limit: No Set Live or send action. Scoped 0 runs before trigger removal and n/a list metrics are not account-wide no-delivery proof.

gaps: Original server settings and IDs were not exported. Clone defaults are not asserted to equal source defaults.
Runtime was not tested because execution is forbidden; this is separate from settings completeness.
All existing node defaults were opened. Shared options are evidence-matched; exhaustive alternative node-type conversion is not proven.
